summary: Decomposed Slice 1 (Browse and Book) and Slice 2 (Identity Ownership) into 6 prescriptive tickets with full 7-section specs, Given/When/Then acceptance criteria, and AI-ready interface contracts under artifacts/tickets/module-05/.
